lead: An untracked non-crate *directory* under a globbed workspace member path breaks every `cargo` call.
body: The root manifest globs `members = ["crates/*", "benches/*"]`, so a directory without a `Cargo.toml` there kills cargo with `failed to read .../Cargo.toml` before any crate is read; through `| tail -3` the error scrolls past and the next run uses a stale `target/debug/nvs.exe`. `cargo metadata --no-deps >/dev/null; echo $?` is the one-call check, and the fix is the `exclude = [...]` line beside the glob.
